checklistGeneric: Test evidence retained with named approver and date
Defects logged and closed before sign-off
checklistSpecific: Run the full UAT rate test deck in the policy admin system and confirm every quote matches the expected premium file
Reconcile each rating factor, territory, and tier table in the engine against the filed rate manual
Confirm minimum premium, maximum premium, and expiring-premium edge cases return filed values rather than defaults
Re-run the deck after the final rate table load and confirm zero variance versus the prior run
Attach the signed rating validation results to the launch ticket

testing.location: UAT quote results for the launch product
testing.expected: UAT quote set matches the expected premium file with zero variances
No open Blocker or Critical rating defect

checklistGeneric: Change record approved by the change advisory board before deployment
Rollback plan documented and tested
checklistSpecific: Confirm the production release build number matches the artifact signed off in UAT
Verify product, rate, and form configuration is present and active in the production policy admin environment
Check that CMDB entries for the new product's interfaces and batch jobs exist and carry a named owner
Confirm the deployment window, freeze exception, and back-out plan are recorded on the change ticket

testing.location: Change record for the launch release
testing.expected: Approved change record with rollback plan attached

checklistGeneric: Approval evidence retained for each jurisdiction
Exceptions escalated before the launch decision
checklistSpecific: Pull the SERFF filing status report and confirm a closed-approved disposition for every launch state
Match each approved form number and edition date to the forms configured in the policy admin system
Confirm the approved effective date in each state is on or before the planned launch date
Remove from launch scope any state that is filed but not yet approved and record the removal
Record every state-specific objection or condition and how it was resolved

testing.location: Filing status by state for the launch product
testing.expected: No launch state in a status other than approved

checklistGeneric: Records stored in the approved repository with retention applied
Access restricted to authorised reviewers
checklistSpecific: Upload the completed readiness checklist, go/no-go minutes, and sign-off sheet to the launch record set
Apply the product-governance retention label to the archived folder
Link the archived evidence pack to the launch entry in the GRC platform
Confirm the pack contains the UAT rating results, state filing approvals, and support readiness confirmations
Lock the record set to read-only once the pack is complete

testing.expected: Complete evidence pack present with the retention label applied

checklistGeneric: Attendance recorded for every required attendee
Briefing materials version-controlled
checklistSpecific: Deliver the supervisor briefing covering the launch-day timeline, cut-over steps, and known workarounds
Walk supervisors through the escalation matrix with named contacts and response commitments
Confirm each supervisor can locate the runbook and the launch-period incident hotline
Record attendance in the LMS and schedule a catch-up session for anyone absent

testing.expected: No required supervisor with incomplete attendance

checklistGeneric: Communication approved before distribution
Distribution list reviewed for completeness
checklistSpecific: Issue the go-live confirmation to servicing, claims, contact centre, and distribution distribution lists
Publish the launch notice and product summary to the broker and agent portal
Notify affected third parties (print vendor, bureau, MGA) with the effective date and support contacts
Confirm the notice states the effective date, the states in scope, and where to raise issues

testing.expected: Published launch notice showing effective date and state list

checklistGeneric: Every criterion scored with supporting evidence
Open items assigned an owner and a due date
checklistSpecific: Score each readiness criterion (rating, filings, systems, training, support, communications) red/amber/green with evidence links
Confirm every amber or red item has a named owner and a resolution date ahead of launch
Reconcile the criteria list against the approved product-approval gate checklist
Capture the assessment outcome and residual risks in the launch record

testing.expected: No unresolved red criterion at the assessment date

checklistGeneric: Escalation contacts confirmed and the on-call rota published
Response commitments agreed with the business
checklistSpecific: Confirm the hypercare rota with named floor-walkers per site and per shift
Verify the launch incident queue, routing rules, and priority definitions are live in the ITSM platform
Check that the help-desk knowledge article for the new product is published and searchable
Agree and record the response and resolution targets that apply during the launch period

testing.location: Launch incident queue and routing rules
testing.expected: Dedicated launch queue live with an assignment group populated

checklistGeneric: Only the approved version is distributed
Recipients acknowledge receipt
checklistSpecific: Publish the approved runbook version to the launch site and mark earlier versions superseded
Send the runbook link to operations, claims, contact centre, and IT support leads
Collect a read-acknowledgement from each team lead before launch day
Confirm a printed copy is available at each contact-centre floor-walk station

testing.expected: Current runbook version marked approved with the acknowledgement list attached

checklistGeneric: Metric owner named for each measure
Thresholds defined for escalation
checklistSpecific: Define the launch metric set (quote volume, bind rate, referral rate, error rate, handle time) with target thresholds
Schedule the daily launch dashboard refresh and the standing daily review for the first two weeks
Set the weekly scorecard distribution list and the date reporting steps down to business-as-usual
Confirm the dashboard pulls the new product code from the warehouse and returns non-zero volumes on day one

testing.expected: Dashboard published for the new product code with a scheduled refresh enabled

checklistGeneric: Document reviewed and approved before issue
Version and author recorded
checklistSpecific: Write the hour-by-hour launch-day timeline from cut-over start to end-of-day confirmation
List each step with its accountable team, system, and expected completion time
Document known-issue workarounds plus the back-out trigger and the person who owns that decision
Include the escalation matrix with names, numbers, and out-of-hours cover
Obtain review sign-off from operations, IT, and product before issuing the runbook

testing.expected: Runbook contains the timeline, RACI, escalation matrix, and back-out trigger

checklistGeneric: Decision taken by the authorised approver
Attendance and outcome minuted
checklistSpecific: Review each readiness criterion against its evidence and confirm the status with the owning team
Confirm every pre-launch condition from the product approval gate is met or formally waived
Take an explicit go, no-go, or go-with-conditions position from each accountable function
Record dissent and any conditions with owners and dates before closing the meeting

testing.expected: Minuted decision showing the named approver and each function's position

checklistGeneric: Each function confirms readiness in writing
Gaps recorded with a mitigation and an owner
checklistSpecific: Obtain written readiness confirmation from the servicing, claims, and contact-centre leads
Confirm product training completion is at or above the agreed threshold for each in-scope team
Verify launch-week rosters cover the forecast volume uplift including the hypercare rota
Check that claims intake screens, call scripts, and correspondence templates reference the new product correctly

testing.location: New product training completion by team
testing.expected: No in-scope team below the agreed training completion threshold

checklistGeneric: Decision record names the approver, date, and basis
Record stored in the governance repository
checklistSpecific: Write the decision statement (go, no-go, or go-with-conditions) with the effective date and states in scope
List each condition with its owner, due date, and the evidence required to close it
Attach the go/no-go attendance list and each function's recorded position
Raise a tracked action for every open condition and confirm none falls due after the launch date
File the signed decision record in the product governance repository

testing.location: Launch decision record and condition actions
testing.expected: No launch condition without a named owner and due date
